svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four rails 1750 long and two side rails 580 long, all 40 x 40 x 2 SHS.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front rail and back rail 660 apart, outside faces; mid rail 320 from front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mid rail carries the rear tower plate; front rail the front plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw square, deburr, tack on a flat floor, check diagonals equal within 3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld all round each joint; cap the open rail ends with 2 mm plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 9 mm for M8: four in each rail under the tower plate tabs,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two at each brace foot on the mid rail, four for the shield posts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue an 80 x 80 x 10 EPDM pad under each corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: the tower plates stand on the front and mid rails, bolted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: frame flat within 3 mm when standing on its pads.
